screening.note: revision-2 screening basis: opened_session stand-in, ticker join, stamp-grid lags

commit_walk.basis: first-parent arrival on origin/main; lane state = first blob per stamp_date; a later BUY-set change = HEAL (GAP)

freeze_basis.basis: W1 r3 receipt sessions; VendorAliasTable membership join, security-first (record-derived candidates confirmed by resolve() on every window session, all candidates of a multi-symbol security); NYSE trading sessions; producer-health coverage on first-arrival blobs
freeze_basis.lane_state_basis: first-arrival blob per stamp_date (first-parent origin/main); healed sessions are GAPs; HEAD never read

alias_knowledge_time.note: membership records carry no validity window; the join uses the current snapshot (knowledge time = its ingest), a disclosed look-ahead on identity labels only; the snapshot sha is pinned per look

provenance.receipt_sessions_source: turn_watch_receipt_sessions(data_root, git_ref='origin/main') from scripts/report_us_candidate_episode_waterfall.py at PR #10277 head d03acfd075d9 (54 receipts); re-derived at freeze, never hand-edited
provenance.lane_state: first-parent ARRIVAL on origin/main (156 commits of the four monthly candidates parquets 2026-07..10): the first blob carrying each stamp_date fixes its BUY rows, curated coverage and signal_asof; a later blob that changes that date's BUY set is a HEAL and the session is a GAP (09-14 +50 BUY rows healed 09-16; 10-19 +104 healed 10-21); HEAD never read for lane state; HEAD disagreement reported (154 BUY rows exist only in the two heals)
provenance.identity_join: security-first: candidate symbols from the membership alias records, EVERY candidate confirmed by VendorAliasTable.resolve('membership', symbol, on=session) == security_id, tested on every healthy window session for every unit (uniform span); alias parquet sha256 pinned
provenance.columns_read: candidates: stamp_date, ticker, tier, lane, eligible, buyable, featured, signal_asof; OPENED episode_id/source_receipt/recorded_at/payload.{ticker_at_observation,opened_session,security_id,identity_epoch}; turn_watch documents (digest-verified) for receipt and commit time; data/reference/vendor_aliases.parquet; data/yahoo/SPY.parquet DATE INDEX only
provenance.knowable_session: first NYSE session whose 16:00 ET close is strictly after the first-parent arrival instant + 30 min; applied per stamp_date (BUY arm) and per receipt (discovery arm); T1 is executable inside K only when k(c_cur) <= t_disc + K
provenance.recorded_at_check: OPENED recorded_at compared as an instant against the T0 fill instant (close of the session after k(c_disc)): 1087/1087 recorded at or before it
